title: Run a macOS Shortcut from the Terminal
summary: Execute a specific Shortcut automation using the command line. This is useful for triggering complex automations without opening the Shortcuts app.

steps.explain: Run the specified Shortcut by name. Replace <SHORTCUT_NAME> with the exact name of your Shortcut.

placeholders.name: SHORTCUT_NAME
placeholders.description: The exact name of the Shortcut you want to run
